description: The controller cannot provide a copy of personal data undergoing processing in a commonly used electronic format when requested electronically.
applicability: Applicable when access requests are made electronically. Data should be provided in a commonly used electronic format unless otherwise requested.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data export capabilities and format options. Verify ability to provide structured, machine-readable copies of personal data.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
